title: Pvp Optimized Pack
description: Highly optimized pvp add-on pack. Designed for weaker computers and maintaining performance on more powerful ones
body:
![PVP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21c4798baab1997e1811dbdfd8a1e1c3376037d4.png)
> **Hello, this modpack is designed for low-end PCs.** 

> > It highly optimizes the game for FPS, ensuring smooth gameplay and minimizing lag. It also has a positive impact on RAM by reducing its usage. 

> > There are also mods that support PvP, suitable for both classic (Axe, Standard) and modern (Crystal, etc.) modes.

> The main mods that provide optimization are sodium, lithium and ferriteCore. You can easly run shaders on it.

> The mods for pvp are type as custom crosshair, combat Hitboxes, totem counter ect. but
you need to remember some of the mods might be banable so read the server rules first

> **I hope you will enjoy my modpack**
